selector.pageSubtitle: Widely-used clinical scales — helping you understand yourself more deeply
selector.disclaimer: Important note: These tests are reference screening tools, not a medical diagnosis. Results are indicative only. If your score is high, please consult a clinical psychologist. This app does not replace professional medical care.
selector.respondentSub:
Enter the name of the person taking the test (a client, student, family member...) — not the name of the logged-in account. This info is shared across every test below, so you only need to fill it in once.
⚠️ If two different people share the same name and age, add a distinguishing mark to the name (e.g. "John Smith - class 5A") to avoid them being merged by mistake when an expert exports a report. Different ages are already kept separate automatically.
ℹ️ "Extra months" only needs to be filled in for the Raven CPM test for children aged 4-11 — used to calculate the standardized (IQ) score for the exact age in months. Other tests don't need it.
📅 You can enter a date of birth to have the system auto-calculate Age/Extra months, or skip it and enter Age/Extra months directly — either way works.
selector.dobTitle: Enter a date of birth to auto-calculate Age/Extra months, or leave blank and fill in Age/Extra months directly
selector.ageMonthsTitle: Only needed for the Raven CPM test (children 4-11 years old) to calculate the standardized score for the exact age in months
